test_cases.summary:
Verify Unauthorized user cannot view S3 actions
when the user lacks S3 permission
test_cases.description:
Feature: Role-Based S3 Access Control
Scenario: Unauthorized user cannot view S3 actions
Given the user lacks S3 permission
When the page loads
Then “Upload from S3” and “Push to S3” options should be hidden or disabled
test_cases.acceptance:
"Upload from S3" and "Push to S3" options should be hidden or disabled
The behavior should be validated when the page loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Upload blocked for unauthorized user
when an unauthorized user attempts to upload from S3
test_cases.description:
Feature: Role-Based S3 Access Control
Scenario: Upload blocked for unauthorized user
Given an unauthorized user attempts to upload from S3
When the action is triggered
Then the system should block the request
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should block the request
The behavior should be validated when the action is triggered.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Push blocked for unauthorized user
when an unauthorized user attempts to push file to S3
test_cases.description:
Feature: Role-Based S3 Access Control
Scenario: Push blocked for unauthorized user
Given an unauthorized user attempts to push file to S3
When the action is triggered
Then the system should block the request
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should block the request
The behavior should be validated when the action is triggered.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Backend permission validation
when the UI is bypassed using direct API call
test_cases.description:
Feature: Role-Based S3 Access Control
Scenario: Backend permission validation
Given the UI is bypassed using direct API call
When an unauthorized request hits the server
Then the API should reject with 403 Forbidden
test_cases.acceptance:
The API should reject with 403 Forbidden
The behavior should be validated when an unauthorized request hits the server.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Access denied notification shown
when unauthorized action attempted
test_cases.description:
Feature: Role-Based S3 Access Control
Scenario: Access denied notification shown
Given unauthorized action attempted
When the system blocks it
Then a clear “Access Denied / Unauthorized” message should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
A clear "Access Denied / Unauthorized" message should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the system blocks it.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Role change reflected immediately
when a user role changes from authorized to unauthorized
test_cases.description:
Feature: Role-Based S3 Access Control
Scenario: Role change reflected immediately
Given a user role changes from authorized to unauthorized
When the page refreshes
Then S3 options should no longer be accessible
test_cases.acceptance:
S3 options should no longer be accessible
The behavior should be validated when the page refreshes.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Permission validated on each action
when authorized user
test_cases.description:
Feature: Role-Based S3 Access Control
Scenario: Permission validated on each action
Given authorized user
When performing multiple S3 operations
Then permission should be validated every time before execution
test_cases.acceptance:
Permission should be validated every time before execution
The behavior should be validated when performing multiple S3 operations.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Disabled controls visually clear
when unauthorized user views page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Role-Based S3 Access Control
Scenario: Disabled controls visually clear
Given unauthorized user views page
When controls are disabled
Then disabled state should be visually distinct and not clickable
test_cases.acceptance:
Disabled state should be visually distinct and not clickable
The behavior should be validated when controls are disabled.

test_cases.summary:
Verify No partial upload occurs on blocked action
when unauthorized user triggers upload
test_cases.description:
Feature: Role-Based S3 Access Control
Scenario: No partial upload occurs on blocked action
Given unauthorized user triggers upload
When request is denied
Then no file transfer or partial data should occur
test_cases.acceptance:
No file transfer or partial data should occur
The behavior should be validated when request is denied.

test_cases.summary:
Verify "Upload from S3" button is displayed on Create Session page
when the user navigates to the Create Session page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – Button Visibility

Scenario: Verify “Upload from S3” button is displayed on Create Session page

Given the user navigates to the Create Session page
When the page loads
Then the “Upload from S3” button should be visible at the top-right corner
test_cases.acceptance:
The "Upload from S3" button should be visible at the top-right corner
The behavior should be validated when the page loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify S3 upload modal opens on button click
when the "Upload from S3" button is visible
test_cases.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – Modal Launch

Scenario: Verify S3 upload modal opens on button click

Given the “Upload from S3” button is visible
When the user clicks the button
Then an upload modal should be displayed with S3 Key input field and Upload button
test_cases.acceptance:
An upload modal should be displayed with S3 Key input field and Upload button
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the button.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Upload button is disabled for empty S3 key
when the S3 upload modal is open
test_cases.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – Upload Button Disabled State

Scenario: Verify Upload button is disabled for empty S3 key

Given the S3 upload modal is open
When the S3 Key field is empty or invalid
Then the Upload button should remain disabled
test_cases.acceptance:
The Upload button should remain disabled
The behavior should be validated when the S3 Key field is empty or invalid.

test_cases.summary:
Verify validation for invalid S3 key format
when the S3 upload modal is open
test_cases.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – S3 Key Validation

Scenario: Verify validation for invalid S3 key format

Given the S3 upload modal is open
When the user enters an incorrectly formatted S3 key
Then a validation message should be displayed
And upload should not proceed
test_cases.acceptance:
A validation message should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user enters an incorrectly formatted S3 key.

test_cases.summary:
Verify JSON file is fetched successfully using valid S3 key
when the user enters a valid S3 key
test_cases.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – Successful File Fetch

Scenario: Verify JSON file is fetched successfully using valid S3 key

Given the user enters a valid S3 key
When the user clicks the Upload button
Then the system should retrieve the JSON file from AWS S3
And validate the JSON structure successfully
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should retrieve the JSON file from AWS S3
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Upload button.

test_cases.summary:
Verify uploaded JSON file name is displayed
when the JSON file is uploaded successfully
test_cases.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – Uploaded File Display

Scenario: Verify uploaded JSON file name is displayed

Given the JSON file is uploaded successfully
When the upload completes
Then the JSON file name should be displayed below the upload area
And a Remove option should be available
test_cases.acceptance:
The JSON file name should be displayed below the upload area
The behavior should be validated when the upload completes.

test_cases.summary:
Verify uploaded JSON metadata is bound to session form
when the JSON file is uploaded successfully
test_cases.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – Bind File to Session State

Scenario: Verify uploaded JSON metadata is bound to session form

Given the JSON file is uploaded successfully
When the user continues session creation
Then the file metadata (name, size, reference path) should be stored in session state
test_cases.acceptance:
The file metadata (name, size, reference path) should be stored in session state
The behavior should be validated when the user continues session creation.

test_cases.summary:
Verify error handling when S3 file is not found or access denied
when the user enters a valid but inaccessible S3 key
test_cases.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – File Not Found Handling

Scenario: Verify error handling when S3 file is not found or access denied

Given the user enters a valid but inaccessible S3 key
When the upload is attempted
Then a failure toast notification should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
A failure toast notification should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the upload is attempted.

test_cases.summary:
Verify invalid JSON structure is rejected
when the uploaded file is retrieved from S3
test_cases.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – Invalid JSON Structure

Scenario: Verify invalid JSON structure is rejected

Given the uploaded file is retrieved from S3
When the JSON structure validation fails
Then the system should reject the file
And display an appropriate error message without breaking the page
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should reject the file
The behavior should be validated when the JSON structure validation fails.

test_cases.summary:
Verify user can remove uploaded JSON file
when a JSON file is uploaded successfully
test_cases.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – Remove Uploaded File

Scenario: Verify user can remove uploaded JSON file

Given a JSON file is uploaded successfully
When the user clicks the Remove option
Then the file should be removed from the UI
And session form state should be cleared of file data
test_cases.acceptance:
The file should be removed from the UI
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Remove option.

test_cases.summary:
Verify the expected behavior
under valid user actions
test_cases.description: Verify large JSON file (>20MB) upload uses streaming without memory spikes
test_cases.acceptance:
Expected result should be displayed as per the scenario.
System should not allow invalid behavior.

test_cases.summary:
Verify the expected behavior
under valid user actions
test_cases.description: Verify success notification is displayed immediately after successful upload or push
test_cases.acceptance:
Expected result should be displayed as per the scenario.
System should not allow invalid behavior.

test_cases.summary:
Verify tooltips are available for S3 action buttons
when the user navigates to the page containing S3 actions
test_cases.description:
Feature: S3 Upload & Push – Tooltip Availability

Scenario: Verify tooltips are available for S3 action buttons

Given the user navigates to the page containing S3 actions
When the page loads
Then tooltips should be available for both Upload from S3 and Push to S3 buttons
test_cases.acceptance:
Tooltips should be available for both Upload from S3 and Push to S3 buttons
The behavior should be validated when the page loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify guidance text for Upload from S3 button
when the Upload from S3 button is visible
test_cases.description:
Feature: S3 Upload & Push – Upload Tooltip Content

Scenario: Verify guidance text for Upload from S3 button

Given the Upload from S3 button is visible
When the user hovers over or focuses on the button
Then a tooltip should be displayed with clear guidance and expected input format
test_cases.acceptance:
A tooltip should be displayed with clear guidance and expected input format
The behavior should be validated when the user hovers over or focuses on the button.

test_cases.summary:
Verify guidance text for Push to S3 button
when the Push to S3 button is visible
test_cases.description:
Feature: S3 Upload & Push – Push Tooltip Content

Scenario: Verify guidance text for Push to S3 button

Given the Push to S3 button is visible
When the user hovers over or focuses on the button
Then a tooltip should be displayed explaining the action purpose and outcome
test_cases.acceptance:
A tooltip should be displayed explaining the action purpose and outcome
The behavior should be validated when the user hovers over or focuses on the button.

test_cases.summary:
Verify tooltips are accessible via keyboard navigation
when the user navigates using the keyboard
test_cases.description:
Feature: S3 Upload & Push – Tooltip Accessibility

Scenario: Verify tooltips are accessible via keyboard navigation

Given the user navigates using the keyboard
When focus is moved to Upload from S3 or Push to S3 buttons
Then the corresponding tooltip should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
The corresponding tooltip should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when focus is moved to Upload from S3 or Push to S3 buttons.

test_cases.summary:
Verify tooltip content loads instantly without delay
when the page containing S3 actions is loaded
test_cases.description:
Feature: S3 Upload & Push – Instant Tooltip Availability

Scenario: Verify tooltip content loads instantly without delay

Given the page containing S3 actions is loaded
When the user hovers over the S3 action buttons
Then the tooltip should appear instantly without additional loading time
test_cases.acceptance:
The tooltip should appear instantly without additional loading time
The behavior should be validated when the user hovers over the S3 action buttons.
